SIMPLE PROCESS

How It Works

We believe handcrafted gifting should feel intimate and stress-free.

01

Explore the collection

Browse our forever flowers, personalised frames, and handcrafted hampers here to find an aesthetic or shape you adore.

02

Choose or customise

Pick your favourite design or message us with your recipient's preferred colours, names, and personal notes.

03

Confirm & we deliver

We handcraft your piece with love, share preview photos, and coordinate safe doorstep delivery across India.

Studio Note: We currently confirm all orders via WhatsApp to ensure attentive 1-on-1 customisation. Direct automated card checkout is in development for future updates.
